import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hud_pit_veteran_counts_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='2023')
df = df[~df['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().isin(['total', 'nan', 'none'])]
df = df.dropna(subset=['State', 'Homeless Veterans, 2023'])
df = df[df['Homeless Veterans, 2023'] != '.']
df['Homeless Veterans, 2023'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Homeless Veterans, 2023'])
result = df.sort_values(by='Homeless Veterans, 2023', ascending=False).iloc[0]['State']
